lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition K6Mg12 (reduced formula KMg2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: K centers have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 neighbors with varying K and Mg counts. The neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between K- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
